additional_fees_detail: Reserva de plaza 450€, verbatim: 'se abonará una vez que se reciba la notificación de admisión al máster, y se descontará del primer pago de matrícula; el importe abonado en concepto de reserva únicamente será devuelto si la Universidad suspende la impartición del máster' — i.e. it is deducted from tuition, not additive, unless the student withdraws. entry_requirements: Verbatim: 'Según la normativa establecida por el Real Decreto 822/2021 de 28 de septiembre de 2021, se requiere que los alumnos del máster estén en posesión de una titulación universitaria previa (al menos titulación de grado o equivalente). Las titulaciones con acceso preferente son aquellas en las siguientes áreas formativas: Estadística. Ciencias Matemáticas. Ciencias Físicas. Ingeniería Informática. Ingeniería Industrial. Ingeniería de Telecomunicaciones.' And: 'No se excluye la posibilidad de que graduados de otras titulaciones puedan acceder a los estudios del máster siempre y cuando cumplan con los requisitos de aptitudes mencionadas en el perfil de ingreso. Para ello, se han de acreditar niveles de conocimiento suficientes en las áreas de Matemáticas (Álgebra y Cálculo), Estadística (Probabilidad e Inferencia) e Informática (habilidades básicas de programación) a través de un formulario específico.' 40 plazas ofertadas. curriculum_summary: One intensive academic year, 39 ECTS compulsory + 15 ECTS optional + 6 ECTS TFM, taught by the Departamento de Estadística with Matemáticas and Informática. La característica definitoria de este máster es que proporciona el mismo peso a ambas componentes.' So it is a statistics-first data science master (methodology + implementation + application), not a tooling/engineering master. credit_recognition_available: Mechanism EXISTS and is documented, but no 300-ECTS-specific entitlement is published. Verbatim: 'All information regarding the recognition and transfer of credits is available here. The Academic Committee of the Master's Degree in Data Science (CAMCD) will assess the requests and draw up the corresponding reports, which will be sent to the Academic Organization Committee of the School of Computer Engineering, which in turn will issue a report and send it to the Vice-Rector's Office for Students. The resolution granting or denying the recognition of credits will be adopted by the President of the Credit Recognition and Transfer Committee in accordance with the provisions of art. 5 d) of the regulations.' So there IS a named, multi-stage route (CAMCD -> ETSIINF Academic Organization Committee -> Vice-Rectorate -> Credit Recognition and Transfer Committee) into which a 300-ECTS applicant can put a request, and UPM maintains a university-wide 'Reconocimiento de Créditos' section. What is NOT published anywhere is any automatic advanced standing, exemption or shortened path for an over-length (300 ECTS, 5-year) prior degree. THE 300-ECTS QUESTION IS THEREFORE: mechanism yes, entitlement NOT FOUND. Note the counter-pressure: the master is only 60 ECTS with 36 compulsory and a 12-ECTS TFM, leaving little that could plausibly be recognised.

curriculum_summary: Four pillars — S1 Fundamentals of Research; S2 Data Processing and Infrastructure; S3 Data Analysis and Exploitation; S4 Societal, Legal and Ethic aspects in Data Science. COMPULSORY (36 ECTS): M1 Introduction to Research Methodology (1,5); M2 Data Visualization (3); M3 Big Data (3); M4 Cloud Computing and Big Data Ecosystems (4,5); M5 Data Processes (4,5); M6 Statistical Data Analysis (4,5); M7 Machine Learning (4,5); M8 Deep Learning (3); M9 Open Data and Knowledge Graphs (4,5); M10 Societal, Legal and Ethic aspects in Data Science (3). ELECTIVES (12 ECTS chosen): O1 Programming for Data Processing (4,5); O2 Data Science Seminars (4,5); O3 Generative AI and Language Models (4,5, marked NEW); O4 Time series Data Mining (3); O5 Graph Analysis and Social Networks (3); O6 Image Processing, Analysis and Classification (4,5); O7 Information Retrieval, Extraction and Integration (4,5). TFM 12 ECTS. Teaching plan verbatim: 'The first semester starts in early September with the course Introduction to Research Methodology taught intensively for three afternoons... On the first semester, 7 mandatory courses and 1 elective course (Generative AI and Language Models) are offered. The second semester runs from February to April... The rest of the semester, until July, is devoted to the development of the Master's Final Project.' ⭐ RELEVANCE TO PATH AC (cloud/distributed): 'M4: Cloud Computing and Big Data Ecosystems (4,5 ECTS)' is COMPULSORY and its description is explicitly infrastructure-facing — 'This course presents traditional data management systems and architectures for scalable distributed systems and data management systems: bigtable, data streaming, persistent queues.' This is the only compulsory cloud/distributed-systems course in any of the data masters in this batch. ⭐ RELEVANCE TO PATHS A/B (music/audio): O4 Time series Data Mining explicitly names AUDIOMETRY among its domains ('medical domains such as Electrocardiography or Audiometry') and covers symbolic approaches to time series — the closest transferable hook to music information retrieval. M8 Deep Learning mentions speech understanding. Nothing music-specific.

thesis_or_internship: Trabajo Fin de Máster / Master's Final Project, 12 ECTS, developed from roughly April to July. Prácticas = 0 ECTS in RUCT; no compulsory internship. Topic assignment: agree directly with a teacher, or choose from a December file of MUCD professors' proposals (rank up to 5), or propose your own. Defence before a 3-lecturer panel, 20-40 minute presentation plus up to 20 minutes of questions, in person or online, in SPANISH OR ENGLISH. Honourable mention possible. The 12-ECTS TFM plus the compulsory research-methodology course make this a genuinely PhD-preparatory master (UPM: 'esta formación puede servir de base tanto para la posterior consecución del título de Doctor como para la incorporación del egresado a la actividad profesional').

(2) THE PROGRAMME'S OWN PERFIL DE INGRESO / PLAN DE ESTUDIOS (the APPLICANT): complementos are COMPULSORY for almost every entry profile and are real, ECTS-bearing, timetabled subjects. Verbatim: 'En función de la titulación y conocimientos previos del alumno, la Comisión Académica del Máster propondrá el itinerario de complementos formativos OBLIGATORIOS a cursar en cada semestre dentro del programa. La oferta de complementos de formación se configurará a partir de la oferta de materias de nivel de grado seleccionadas de entre la oferta académica de la UPM para cada curso académico. Los complementos de formación servirán para homogeneizar el perfil de ingreso de los alumnos.' THE FOUR COURSES AND THEIR CREDITS, verbatim from the ETSIST plan table: 'Acústica CF — 3 ECTS — 1º (otoño) — D250'; 'Acústica Arquitectónica CF — 3 ECTS — 1º (otoño) — D250'; 'Electroacústica CF — 3 ECTS — 2º (primavera) — D250'; 'Procesado Digital de Señal CF — 3 ECTS — 1º (otoño)'. Total 12 ECTS. THE ALLOCATION FOR THIS CANDIDATE, verbatim: 'Graduados/Ingenieros de otras ramas (sin conocimientos previos de Acústica y Procesado de Señal): Acústica CF; Acústica Arquitectónica CF; Electroacústica CF; Procesado Digital de la Señal CF' — ALL FOUR, i.e. the full 12 ECTS. Only one profile escapes entirely: 'Ingeniero Técnico de Telecomunicación, Sonido e Imagen: En este caso no existen complementos formativos obligatorios.' PROCEDURE, verbatim: complementos 'se harán constar en la carta de admisión al programa de Máster para cada estudiante' — so the applicant learns their load only in the admission letter. NET EFFECT: a Software Engineering graduate faces 60 + 12 = 72 ECTS and roughly 1,009 EUR of extra non-EU tuition. RUCT's 0 would have got this badly wrong.

curriculum_summary: Structure per the programme site: FUNDAMENTOS (9 ECTS) + TECNOLOGÍAS (10,5 ECTS) + APLICACIONES (16,5 ECTS) = 36 ECTS common core, then INTENSIFICACIÓN (24 ECTS) built from Seminarios / Prácticas en empresas / Optativas / Trabajo Fin de Máster. FIRST SEMESTER (otoño), all 4,5 ECTS obligatorias unless noted: Ingeniería Acústica (D420/D250); Psicoacústica (D250/D230); Acústica Ambiental (D420); Aislamiento Acústico (D250/D230); Control de Ruido y Vibraciones (D420/D250); Instrumentación y Metrología Acústica (D420/D230/D250); plus optatives Sistemas Constructivos (3), Movilidad I (3), Prácticas Externas I (3), Prácticas Externas III (6). SECOND SEMESTER (primavera), 3 ECTS obligatorias: Técnicas Ultrasónicas (D420); TRATAMIENTO DE SEÑALES ACÚSTICAS (D250/D230); Métodos Numéricos en Acústica (D420/D440); plus optatives Movilidad II (3), Prácticas Externas II (3), Prácticas Externas III (6). TFM 15 ECTS, in either period. 9 ECTS of optatividad freely spread across the two semesters. ⭐ RELEVANCE TO PATHS C AND A: this is the most audio-specific curriculum in the entire batch. 'Psicoacústica' (4,5) and 'Tratamiento de Señales Acústicas' (3) are the direct hits for a sound-and-music-computing candidate, and the UPM catalogue's own field list names 'Tratamiento Digital de Señales Acústicas' as one of the six strategic areas alongside Acústica Ambiental, Acústica Arquitectónica, Control de Ruido y Vibraciones, Aplicaciones Ultrasónicas and Tecnologías e Instrumentación Acústica. ⚠️ BUT the centre of gravity is NOISE, BUILDING AND ULTRASOUND ACOUSTICS, not music technology: there is no music, no audio production, no MIR and no music-AI content anywhere in the plan. Treat it as path C (audio DSP / acoustics), not as path A. Method, verbatim: 'La metodología utilizada se basa en el estudio de casos prácticos y el aprendizaje basado en proyectos. El alumno analiza, concibe, diseña y desarrolla proyectos de distinto tipo en cada uno de los campos de la ingeniería acústica.'

complementary_credits_required: 0 (RUCT) — RUCT 4314315 publishes 'Nº Créditos Complementos Formativos: 0' for the title. Verbatim from the admission baremo: 'Número de créditos de complementos formativos requeridos: de 5 a 15 puntos.' In other words the Comisión Académica calculates, per applicant, how many complementos that person would need, and awards MORE points the FEWER are required. The programme does not publish a list of complementos subjects or their ECTS — that list is NOT FOUND. credit_recognition_available: ⭐ YES — AND THIS IS THE ONLY PROGRAMME IN THE BATCH THAT PUBLISHES A QUANTIFIED CEILING, which makes it the best available primary-source answer to the 300-ECTS question. Verbatim from the programme's 'Transferencia y reconocimiento de créditos' section: 'No podrán ser objeto de reconocimiento los créditos correspondientes a los trabajos de fin de Grado y de Máster, ni los estudios reconocidos podrán superar el 60% de los créditos del plan de estudios o del currículo del título de grado que se pretende cursar, siempre que se trate de reconocimiento de estudios entre las diferentes enseñanzas que constituyen la educación superior, según establece el R.D. 1618/2011, de 14 de noviembre. TAMPOCO PODRÁ SUPERARSE EL 50 % DE LOS CRÉDITOS EN LOS ESTUDIOS DE MÁSTER.' READ AGAINST THIS DEGREE: 50% of 90 ECTS = 45 ECTS is the absolute ceiling, but the 30-ECTS TFM is explicitly excluded from recognition, so in practice the recognisable pool is the 60 taught ECTS and the binding limit is 45 — meaning a well-evidenced 300-ECTS entrant could in principle have up to 45 of the 60 taught credits recognised and finish substantially faster. THAT IS A CEILING, NOT AN ENTITLEMENT: nothing published grants any specific recognition for an over-length foreign degree. PROCEDURE, verbatim: 'El procedimiento se iniciará a solicitud del interesado que deberá ser presentada mediante el formulario electrónico de reconocimiento de créditos. La presentación de la documentación requerida deberá realizarse en la Secretaría del Centro, o enviada a través del registro electrónico, acompañada de la solicitud impresa... El plazo máximo para resolver y notificar las resoluciones será de tres meses contados desde la fecha de recibo de la documentación completa.' NOTE THE THREE-MONTH RESOLUTION WINDOW — a recognition request must be filed early. COST, verbatim: 'El reconocimiento de créditos estará sujeto al pago de los Precios Públicos que para cada curso académico apruebe la Comunidad de Madrid' — recognised credits are still charged unless they come from adapting an unfinished prior qualification named in the memoria de verificación. curriculum_summary: ⭐ THE PUREST PATH-AC PROGRAMME IN THE BATCH — a Spanish official master whose TITLE and whose entire 60-ECTS taught core are distributed and embedded systems. All subjects compulsory. SEMESTRE 1 (30 ECTS): Sistemas Distribuidos (6); Servicios y Protocolos de Aplicaciones en Internet (6); Sistemas Empotrados (6); Ingeniería del Software de Sistemas (6); Sistemas de Control (3); Seminarios (3). SEMESTRE 2 (30 ECTS): Sistemas Distribuidos Tolerantes a Fallos (3); Ciencia de los Datos (3); Redes Inalámbricas (6); Seguridad en Sistemas y Redes (6); Programación Avanzada de Smartphones (6); Sistemas de Tiempo Real Distribuidos (6). SEMESTRE 3: Proyecto de Fin de Máster (30). Application domains per the UPM catalogue, verbatim: 'seguridad de servicios en red; smartgrids; smartcitys; desarrollo de aplicaciones para dispositivos de acceso personal; robótica'. Skills, verbatim: 'Programación de smartphones; Administración de seguridad de redes cableadas e inalámbricas; Diseño y desarollo de sistemas distribuidos tolerantes a fallos; Programación de sistemas de control y de tiempo de real.' Graduate profile, verbatim: 'un profesional con capacidad tanto para dirigir como para formar parte de equipos de trabajo que diseñen, desarrollen, validen y/o auditen software de sistemas distribuidos y empotrados.' ⚠️ HOW IT DIFFERS FROM 'CLOUD/DEVOPS': the taught plan is fault-tolerant distributed systems, real-time and embedded software, wireless networks and network security — it is NOT a cloud-platform or SRE curriculum, and the words cloud, Kubernetes and DevOps appear nowhere in the subject list. THEY DO APPEAR IN THE STUDENT WORK: published TFM titles include 'Desarrollo y despliegue automático de un sistema de sensorización y actuación smart agriculture de acuerdo a principios DevOps y GitOps' (2023), 'Desarrollo y Despliegue de Sistemas IoT Edge usando Kubernetes y aplicando principios GitOps' (2023), 'Infraestructura de monitorización de la confiabilidad de un sistema IoT' (2021) and 'Coordinación de un sistema distribuido con Raft' (2021). So the DevOps/cloud angle is reachable through the 30-ECTS TFM rather than through coursework — which, given the TFM is a third of the degree, is a real route.

non_eu_surcharge: YES — explicit, published on the programme's own page as a named two-tier table, and legally grounded in the Valencian decree. UPV's microsite prints, verbatim: 'PRECIO DEL CRÉDITO — Estudiantado tipo 1 * : 35,34 € (curso 26-27) — Estudiantado tipo 2 * : 70,68 € (curso 26-27)' and 'PRECIO TOTAL — Estudiantado tipo 1 *: Desde 2120,4 € (curso 26-27) — Estudiantado tipo 2 *: Desde 4240,8 € (curso 26-27)', with the definitions verbatim: '(*) Tipo 1: Estudiantado nacional, de la UE y extranjero residente en España (importante: la autorización de estancia concedida a estudiantes extranjeros no equivale a la condición de residente)' and '(*) Tipo 2: Resto de estudiantado internacional'. THE SURCHARGE IS EXACTLY x2: 70,68 = 2 x 35,34. That matches DECRETO 101/2024 (DOGV núm. 9913, 12.08.2024), art. 6.1, verbatim: 'Al estudiantado extranjero, que no tenga la condición de residente, excluidos los nacionales de Estados miembros de la Unión Europea y aquellos a quienes les sea de aplicación el régimen comunitario, se le aplicará EL DOBLE de los precios públicos establecidos en el anexo I para los servicios académicos universitarios, sin que el precio correspondiente pueda exceder del cien por cien (100%) del coste del servicio académico.' THE RESIDENCY TRAP IS CLOSED TWICE OVER — once by the decree, art. 6.3 verbatim: 'A estos efectos, la autorización de estancia concedida a los estudiantes extranjeros de acuerdo con el Real decreto 557/2011, de 20 de abril ... no equivaldrá a la condición de residentes'; and again in UPV's own footnote quoted above. A Tunisian citizen on a Spanish long-stay study authorisation is Tipo 2 and CANNOT become Tipo 1 by living in Valencia. TRANSITIONAL RELIEF DOES NOT APPLY TO A 2027 ENTRANT: the decree's Disposición transitoria primera set 1.5x (not 2x) only 'Para el curso académico 2024-2025, al nuevo estudiantado extranjero'. By curso 26-27 the full 2x applies, which is what UPV's own table shows. EXCEPTIONS THE DECREE ITSELF NAMES (art. 6.2), verbatim: 'Quedan exceptuados del apartado anterior los másteres con precio especial interuniversitario con universidades españolas y aquellos másteres con precio excepcional que ya establezcan un precio especial superior al doble de los másteres del apartado 2.2 del anexo I.' — i.e. 'precio excepcional' masters are outside the doubling rule and must be priced from their own tariff. ONE MORE VALENCIAN COST RULE WORTH KNOWING (art. 4.1), verbatim: 'El estudiantado que obtenga el reconocimiento o la transferencia de créditos por estudios o actividades realizadas en cualquier centro de educación superior, abonará a la Universidad el veinticinco por ciento (25%) de los importes establecidos en el anexo I.' — recognised credits cost 25% of the normal price, so advanced standing in Valencia is genuinely cheaper, unlike at UPM.

curriculum_summary: ⭐ THE STRONGEST PURE CLOUD/HPC (PATH AC) CURRICULUM IN THE BATCH, and the only one that names specific cloud platforms and parallel-programming toolchains. Verbatim from 'En detalle': 'En este máster, no solo aprenderás a diseñar arquitecturas resilientes y automatizar despliegues en plataformas cloud como AWS o Azure, sino que también te formarás en la programación paralela y optimización de aplicaciones que ejecutan simulaciones complejas, algoritmos matriciales, modelos meteorológicos, análisis genómicos y otras tareas científicas de gran demanda computacional. Todo ello combinado con el tratamiento masivo de datos propio del Big Data y la Inteligencia Artificial.' And: 'Explorarás el funcionamiento de dispositivos hardware avanzados, como GPUs y procesadores multicore, y te familiarizarás con herramientas clave como OpenMP, CUDA, MPI o Threading Building Blocks. Además, aprenderás a optimizar el rendimiento del código secuencial utilizando compiladores avanzados de GNU o de Intel OneAPI, y a desplegar estos entornos sobre infraestructuras cloud adaptadas a las exigencias de cada aplicación.' OBJECTIVES name container orchestration explicitly: 'Con amplios conocimientos sobre las arquitecturas de las plataformas cloud y de la gestión y orquestación de contenedores software'; plus 'diseño y desarrollo de servicios distribuidos eficientes y elásticos a desplegar en sistemas cloud', 'algorítmica paralela', and 'desarrollar aplicaciones que garanticen la continuidad de su servicio, incluso cuando éstas sean actualizadas'. CAREER OUTCOMES the page itself lists, verbatim: 'Arquitecto Cloud'; 'INGENIERO DE DEVOPS Y AUTOMATIZACIÓN: Automatización de despliegues, integración continua y monitorización en entornos cloud y de alto rendimiento'; 'Especialista en Computación de Altas Prestaciones (HPC)'; 'Ingeniero de Big Data e Inteligencia Artificial'; 'Administrador de Plataformas Cloud y HPC'; 'Desarrollador de Software de Alto Rendimiento'; 'Consultor en Transformación Digital e Infraestructura Cloud'. ⚠️ SUBJECT-LEVEL PLAN NOT RETRIEVED: the microsite's /asignaturas/ page renders its table via JavaScript and returns an empty body to every automated fetch (confirmed on both a live fetch and a cached copy). RUCT's breakdown (32 obligatorios + 16 optativos + 12 TFM) is the only credit-level structure I can source. The subject list needs a human with a normal browser — recorded as a gap, not invented.

language_requirement: ⭐ NONE PUBLISHED — 'REQUISITO LINGÜÍSTICO: No', verbatim, in the microsite header. This is the significant contrast with UPV's MUCNAP, which on the identical template prints 'REQUISITO LINGÜÍSTICO: Español – B2' and enforces an ACLES-certificated Spanish B2 for applicants from non-Spanish-speaking countries. Here NO Spanish certificate is required for admission. ⚠️ THAT DOES NOT MAKE IT LANGUAGE-NEUTRAL. Teaching is in Español/Valenciano, and admission includes an individual interview weighted at 30% ('Entrevista individual de selección — 30% (w = 0.3)'), which will in practice be conducted in Spanish. So the certificate bar is absent but the functional Spanish requirement is not. For a candidate at A0/A1 now and B1-B2 at best by September 2027, this programme is REACHABLE ON PAPER in a way MUCNAP is not, but the 30%-weighted interview is a real obstacle.

non_eu_surcharge: YES — explicit, published on the programme's own page as a named two-tier table, and legally grounded in the Valencian decree. UPV's microsite prints, verbatim: 'PRECIO DEL CRÉDITO — Estudiantado tipo 1 * : 35,34 € (curso 26-27) — Estudiantado tipo 2 * : 70,68 € (curso 26-27)' and 'PRECIO TOTAL — Estudiantado tipo 1 *: Desde 2120,4 € (curso 26-27) — Estudiantado tipo 2 *: Desde 4240,8 € (curso 26-27)', with the definitions verbatim: '(*) Tipo 1: Estudiantado nacional, de la UE y extranjero residente en España (importante: la autorización de estancia concedida a estudiantes extranjeros no equivale a la condición de residente)' and '(*) Tipo 2: Resto de estudiantado internacional'. THE SURCHARGE IS EXACTLY x2: 70,68 = 2 x 35,34. That matches DECRETO 101/2024 (DOGV núm. 9913, 12.08.2024), art. 6.1, verbatim: 'Al estudiantado extranjero, que no tenga la condición de residente, excluidos los nacionales de Estados miembros de la Unión Europea y aquellos a quienes les sea de aplicación el régimen comunitario, se le aplicará EL DOBLE de los precios públicos establecidos en el anexo I para los servicios académicos universitarios, sin que el precio correspondiente pueda exceder del cien por cien (100%) del coste del servicio académico.' THE RESIDENCY TRAP IS CLOSED TWICE OVER — once by the decree, art. 6.3 verbatim: 'A estos efectos, la autorización de estancia concedida a los estudiantes extranjeros de acuerdo con el Real decreto 557/2011, de 20 de abril ... no equivaldrá a la condición de residentes'; and again in UPV's own footnote quoted above. A Tunisian citizen on a Spanish long-stay study authorisation is Tipo 2 and CANNOT become Tipo 1 by living in Valencia. TRANSITIONAL RELIEF DOES NOT APPLY TO A 2027 ENTRANT: the decree's Disposición transitoria primera set 1.5x (not 2x) only 'Para el curso académico 2024-2025, al nuevo estudiantado extranjero'. By curso 26-27 the full 2x applies, which is what UPV's own table shows. EXCEPTIONS THE DECREE ITSELF NAMES (art. 6.2), verbatim: 'Quedan exceptuados del apartado anterior los másteres con precio especial interuniversitario con universidades españolas y aquellos másteres con precio excepcional que ya establezcan un precio especial superior al doble de los másteres del apartado 2.2 del anexo I.' — i.e. 'precio excepcional' masters are outside the doubling rule and must be priced from their own tariff. ONE MORE VALENCIAN COST RULE WORTH KNOWING (art. 4.1), verbatim: 'El estudiantado que obtenga el reconocimiento o la transferencia de créditos por estudios o actividades realizadas en cualquier centro de educación superior, abonará a la Universidad el veinticinco por ciento (25%) de los importes establecidos en el anexo I.' — recognised credits cost 25% of the normal price, so advanced standing in Valencia is genuinely cheaper, unlike at UPM.
additional_fees_detail: NOT FOUND as itemised programme-level figures; the microsite links only 'Consulta toda la información sobre las tasas académicas'. Valencian statutory service fees from DECRETO 101/2024 Anexo II that will bear on this candidate: 'reconocimiento de créditos correspondiente a estudios extranjeros — 143,73 €' and 'Equivalencia de títulos extranjeros para el acceso a los estudios de máster o doctorado para titulados extranjeros sin título homologado — 155,22 €' (the latter almost certainly payable on the non-homologated access route). UPV's own total is written 'Desde 4240,8 €' — a floor, not a ceiling.
entry_requirements: Deliberately broad. Verbatim: 'Podrán ser admitidos como alumnos del Máster aquellos alumnos: Pertenecientes a países del Espacio Europeo de Educación Superior y estén en posesión de un título Universitario expedido por una Institución Europea Superior que faculta en el país expedidor del título para el acceso a las enseñanzas de Máster. No pertenecientes al Espacio Europeo de Educación Superior que estén en posesión de un título universitario de nivel de formación equivalente a los correspondientes títulos universitarios españoles y que faculta en el país expedidor del título para el acceso a las enseñanzas de posgrado.' — NO degree-field restriction whatsoever is imposed at the access stage. TARGET AUDIENCE, verbatim: 'El Máster está diseñado para atraer a estudiantes con diversos antecedentes académicos: Graduados de carreras técnicas (ingenierías); Titulados en ciencias; Graduados en economía; Interesados en el tratamiento estadístico de datos experimentales; Personas enfocadas en el desarrollo de modelos estadísticos y de optimización; Usuarios de modelos matemáticos; Apasionados por las técnicas de inteligencia artificial.' WEIGHTED SELECTION, verbatim: 'A Nota media del expediente académico — 30% (w = 0.3). B Idoneidad del perfil de formación — 10% (w = 0.1). C Currículo profesional — 20% (w = 0.2). D Formación complementaria y otros méritos — 10% (w = 0.1). E Entrevista individual de selección — 30% (w = 0.3).' 22 places for curso 26-27.
accepts_engineering_background: EXPLICIT YES, in the broadest terms of any UPV programme in this batch. 'Graduados de carreras técnicas (ingenierías)' is the FIRST named target group and the access rule imposes no field restriction at all — only an equivalent-level foreign degree giving postgraduate access at home. Quoted, not inferred. ⭐ NOTE THE SELECTION SHAPE FAVOURS THIS CANDIDATE'S PROFILE UNUSUALLY WELL: only 10% rides on 'Idoneidad del perfil de formación' (degree fit), while 20% is 'Currículo profesional' and a further 10% 'Formación complementaria y otros méritos' — so professional and non-degree evidence carries 30%, three times the weight given to how closely the first degree matches. A working software engineer and music producer has real room to score here.
complementary_credits_required: NOT PUBLISHED IN RUCT — RUCT 4311606 omits the 'Nº Créditos Complementos Formativos' row entirely (null in output/ruct-detail.jsonl), which is NOT the same as 0. AT APPLICANT LEVEL the programme publishes NO complementos formativos scheme: the Admisión page moves straight from access requirements to weighted selection criteria with no bridging-credit provision at all. ⚠️ ONE POINT OF POSSIBLE CONFUSION, WORTH STATING EXPLICITLY SO IT IS NOT MISREAD: the 9-ECTS optional module is called 'Materia: Formación complementaria en análisis de datos, mejora de procesos y toma de decisiones'. Despite the words 'Formación complementaria', this is an OPTATIVE MODULE INSIDE THE 60 ECTS ('Módulo 2. Módulo Optativo: 9 ects optativos'), not a complementos-formativos bridge on top of the degree. There is no evidence of extra credits being imposed on any entry profile. I am quoting the programme's En detalle / Admisión pages for the applicant-level position and recording RUCT's row as ABSENT rather than as zero.
credit_recognition_available: NOT FOUND as a programme-specific entitlement — no advanced-standing or reconocimiento rule keyed to an over-length prior degree is published on the master's pages. UPV's university-wide 'Normativa de reconocimiento y transferencia de créditos' applies. ⭐ WHAT IS PUBLISHED AND MATTERS FINANCIALLY: DECRETO 101/2024 art. 4.1, verbatim — 'El estudiantado que obtenga el reconocimiento o la transferencia de créditos por estudios o actividades realizadas en cualquier centro de educación superior, abonará a la Universidad el veinticinco por ciento (25%) de los importes establecidos en el anexo I.' For a Tipo 2 student that is 17,67 EUR per recognised credit instead of 70,68 — recognition in Valencia saves 75% of the credit price. Art. 3 confirms TFM and prácticas credits are always charged in full. A statutory 143,73 EUR fee applies to 'reconocimiento de créditos correspondiente a estudios extranjeros'. So the 300-ECTS question here is: no published entitlement, but a mechanism that is unusually cheap to use if the Comisión Académica grants anything. The programme's own optional module is only 9 ECTS, so realistically only the optativos are recognisable without touching the 39 compulsory ECTS or the 12-ECTS TFM.

Joint-cheapest non-EU programme in the batch alongside UPV MUCNAP. ⭐ WHY THIS IS THE MOST REACHABLE UPV PROGRAMME FOR THIS CANDIDATE: it is the only UPV master in the batch whose header prints 'REQUISITO LINGÜÍSTICO: No' — no Spanish certificate is demanded at admission, unlike MUCNAP's ACLES-certificated 'Español – B2'. Reachable on paper is not the same as survivable in class at B1-B2. ⚠️ AND CHECK THE CONTENT FIT BEFORE RANKING IT HIGH: despite the 'Análisis de Datos' in the title, the largest compulsory materia is 'Mejora de Procesos' (19.5 of 39 compulsory ECTS). RUCT files it under 'Matemáticas y estadística' and it is taught by the statistics and operations-research department. It is a quality/process-engineering master with data analysis attached, not a computing or ML master, and it has no audio or music content at all. non_eu_surcharge: YES — explicit, published on the programme's own page as a named two-tier table, and legally grounded in the Valencian decree. UPV's microsite prints, verbatim: 'PRECIO DEL CRÉDITO — Estudiantado tipo 1 * : 35,34 € (curso 26-27) — Estudiantado tipo 2 * : 70,68 € (curso 26-27)' and 'PRECIO TOTAL — Estudiantado tipo 1 *: Desde 2120,4 € (curso 26-27) — Estudiantado tipo 2 *: Desde 4240,8 € (curso 26-27)', with the definitions verbatim: '(*) Tipo 1: Estudiantado nacional, de la UE y extranjero residente en España (importante: la autorización de estancia concedida a estudiantes extranjeros no equivale a la condición de residente)' and '(*) Tipo 2: Resto de estudiantado internacional'. THE SURCHARGE IS EXACTLY x2: 70,68 = 2 x 35,34. That matches DECRETO 101/2024 (DOGV núm. 9913, 12.08.2024), art. 6.1, verbatim: 'Al estudiantado extranjero, que no tenga la condición de residente, excluidos los nacionales de Estados miembros de la Unión Europea y aquellos a quienes les sea de aplicación el régimen comunitario, se le aplicará EL DOBLE de los precios públicos establecidos en el anexo I para los servicios académicos universitarios, sin que el precio correspondiente pueda exceder del cien por cien (100%) del coste del servicio académico.' THE RESIDENCY TRAP IS CLOSED TWICE OVER — once by the decree, art. 6.3 verbatim: 'A estos efectos, la autorización de estancia concedida a los estudiantes extranjeros de acuerdo con el Real decreto 557/2011, de 20 de abril ... no equivaldrá a la condición de residentes'; and again in UPV's own footnote quoted above. A Tunisian citizen on a Spanish long-stay study authorisation is Tipo 2 and CANNOT become Tipo 1 by living in Valencia. TRANSITIONAL RELIEF DOES NOT APPLY TO A 2027 ENTRANT: the decree's Disposición transitoria primera set 1.5x (not 2x) only 'Para el curso académico 2024-2025, al nuevo estudiantado extranjero'. By curso 26-27 the full 2x applies, which is what UPV's own table shows. EXCEPTIONS THE DECREE ITSELF NAMES (art. 6.2), verbatim: 'Quedan exceptuados del apartado anterior los másteres con precio especial interuniversitario con universidades españolas y aquellos másteres con precio excepcional que ya establezcan un precio especial superior al doble de los másteres del apartado 2.2 del anexo I.' — i.e. 'precio excepcional' masters are outside the doubling rule and must be priced from their own tariff. ONE MORE VALENCIAN COST RULE WORTH KNOWING (art. 4.1), verbatim: 'El estudiantado que obtenga el reconocimiento o la transferencia de créditos por estudios o actividades realizadas en cualquier centro de educación superior, abonará a la Universidad el veinticinco por ciento (25%) de los importes establecidos en el anexo I.' — recognised credits cost 25% of the normal price, so advanced standing in Valencia is genuinely cheaper, unlike at UPM.

A Software Engineering degree is NOT among the ten named target profiles (which are telecom, industrial, civil, architecture, physics and environmental science). Access is not formally closed — the general RD 861/2010 route is open to any equivalent-level foreign degree and there are no entrance exams — but the scoring formula multiplies the academic record by a 'coeficiente de idoneidad' (suitability coefficient) whose value is not published, and awards up to 3 points for 'años de experiencia profesional EN LA INGENIERÍA ACÚSTICA' and 0.2 per course 'dentro del campo de la acústica'. A software engineer with no acoustics record scores zero on both of those terms and an unknown, probably reduced, idoneidad coefficient. I am recording this as INFERRED FROM THE PUBLISHED FORMULA, not as a stated acceptance or rejection. ⭐ MITIGATION THE PAGE ITSELF OFFERS: 'cursos recibidos dentro del campo de la acústica [hasta 5 cursos]' and '1 punto por otros méritos y motivación' — a working music producer can build an acoustics/audio course record and argue it in the motivation letter, and the letter explicitly invites a statement of doctoral intent.

REALISTIC SCOPE HERE: 38 of the 60 ECTS are the compulsory acoustics core, which a software-engineering transcript will not displace; the 10-ECTS specialisation block and, at most, parts of the 14-ECTS 'Métodos y herramientas' materia are the only plausible targets. The header's 'No' most likely means 'no SPANISH requirement' (the same field reads 'Español – B2' on the MUCNAP microsite), but that reading is an interpretation and is flagged as such. A search-engine summary encountered while locating this programme stated it is 'taught in Spanish, Valenciano, and English (B2 level)'. The UPV microsite header lists ONLY 'Español / Valenciano' as IDIOMA DE IMPARTICIÓN; the English B2 appears solely as an admission requirement on the Admisión page. notes: COST ARITHMETIC, SHOWN: Tipo 2 (non-EU non-resident) 70,68 EUR/ECTS x 60 = 4,240.80 EUR — UPV's own printed 'Desde 4240,8 €'. Tipo 1 35,34 x 60 = 2,120.40 EUR. Surcharge +2,120.40 EUR (x2 per DECRETO 101/2024 art. 6.1). Probably plus 155,22 EUR for the foreign-degree equivalence assessment. Joint-cheapest non-EU programme in the batch. ⭐⭐ THE SINGLE MOST INTERESTING FINDING IN THIS BATCH FOR A SOUND-AND-MUSIC CANDIDATE, and it is a programme the register alone would never surface: UPV Gandia's acoustics master publishes 'Acústica musical' and 'Tratamiento y procesado de audio' among its research lines, names 'Ingeniero de Sonido: Especialización en la producción musical, diseño de sonido para cine, televisión y videojuegos' among its career outcomes, sits on a campus built around the Sonido e Imagen telecom degree, and has an anechoic chamber, a reverberation chamber and a dedicated Laboratorio Tratamiento Digital de la Señal. Compare UPM's identically-named Ingeniería Acústica master, which is pure noise/building/ultrasound with no music content whatsoever. ⭐ AND THE LANGUAGE RULE IS BACKWARDS FROM WHAT YOU WOULD EXPECT: the only certificated requirement is ENGLISH B2 for foreign applicants — which this candidate already meets — with a published no-certificate fallback (a competence interview requested in the motivation letter). No Spanish certificate at all, unlike UPV MUCNAP. ⚠️ THE TWO REAL RISKS: (1) teaching is in Español/Valenciano regardless of the English admission rule, so classroom survivability at B1-B2 remains the open question; (2) the admission formula multiplies the transcript by an unpublished 'coeficiente de idoneidad' and awards points only for acoustics experience and acoustics courses, on none of which a software engineer starts with anything. The counter-move the page itself invites: accumulate acoustics/audio courses (worth 0.2 each up to 5) and use the motivation letter, which is explicitly scored and explicitly asks about doctoral intent. ⚠️ ALSO NOTE: 28 places, the largest in the batch, and for curso 26-27 this master opened in ALL FOUR preinscription phases including one still live on the access date — it is materially easier to get into on timing alone than anything else here. TWO GAPS FOR A HUMAN BROWSER: the 'ASIGNATURAS' subject table and the 'Empresas colaboradoras' list both render empty to automated fetching.

official_status: máster universitario (OFFICIAL) — and the programme states its own RUCT code, which is the strongest form of evidence the shared brief asks for. Verbatim from the programme page: 'The Master of Music in scoring for film, television, and video games is additionally accredited by Spanish educational authorities (CÓDIGO RUCT DEL TÍTULO: 4313419). Berklee College of Music's Valencia campus (Berklee Valencia), the authorized center of higher education in arts, imparts this program under affiliation with Universidad Politécnica de Valencia (UPV) and it is valid throughout the European Higher Education Area (EHEA).' And on the centre: 'Berklee Valencia is a Centro Superior Autorizado de Enseñanzas Artísticas de la Música, Código del centro: 46061691 (Authorized Higher Education Center for Artistic Music Education) in the European Higher Education Area, officially recognized as such by Resolution of the General Director of Universities, Higher Studies and Sciences no. 6844, dated August 8, 2012. [DOCV no. 6844, 08.21.2012, SPAIN].' RUCT 4313419 CONFIRMS IT INDEPENDENTLY. Estado: 'Publicado en B.O.E. (TITULACIÓN RENOVADA)'. Nivel académico: Máster - RD 1393/2007 (1); Nivel MECES 3; Rama: Artes y Humanidades; Campo: 'Industrias Culturales: diseño, animación, cinematografía y producción audiovisual'. Fecha de verificación 19/09/2012; BOE 15/11/2013, 22/07/2014, 23/04/2019; accreditation renewals 24/05/2021 and 10/05/2017. Wave-1 additionally recorded a 'Modificación no sustancial' dated 12/09/2024, i.e. the title was still being actively maintained two years before access date. ⭐ NOTE THE STRUCTURE CAREFULLY: this is a DUAL award. It is (a) a US Master of Music accredited by NECHE — verbatim, 'All graduate programs at Berklee are accredited by the New England Commission of Higher Education ... which is internationally recognized as an authority on educational quality' — AND (b) a Spanish official máster universitario registered to UPV. It is NOT a título propio, and it is NOT a Máster en Enseñanzas Artísticas outside RUCT: it is in RUCT, under a public university. ⚠️ ONE UNRESOLVED FLAG CARRIED FORWARD FROM WAVE 1: this title is absent from UPV's own 2026-27 master catalogue feed. That is consistent with the teaching centre being Berklee rather than a UPV school, but it means the UPV-side listing could not be cross-checked. See conflicts.
ects_breakdown: RUCT: 48 obligatorios + 6 optativos + 0 prácticas + 6 TFM = 60. ⚠️ CONTRAST WITH THE BERKLEE-SIDE DESCRIPTION: Berklee describes the same programme as 'three semesters of study—or one full academic year: fall, spring, and summer semesters' and prices it per credit at USD 1,615 on a US credit system, not on ECTS. The two credit systems sit side by side; the 60-ECTS figure is the Spanish registered structure. Berklee's own 'culminating experience' corresponds to the 6-ECTS TFM.
modality: presencial (fully on-campus, Valencia). Verbatim: 'All graduate programs on the Valencia campus are designed to be completed in three semesters of study—or one full academic year: fall, spring, and summer semesters.' Programme start: September 2026 for the 2026/2027 academic year.
language_of_instruction_verbatim: Programme page, 'Program Information' block, verbatim: 'Language — English (all classes are taught in English)'. This is an explicit primary-source statement on the programme's own page, not an inference from an English-language website. ⚠️ CAVEAT ON PROVENANCE: unlike the UPV masters, this statement is on Berklee's site rather than on a Spanish-language UPV plan de estudios page; UPV publishes no catalogue entry for this title (see conflicts), so no Spanish-language 'idioma de impartición' field could be cross-checked. The statement is nonetheless unambiguous and comes from the institution that teaches the programme.
language_requirement: NOT FOUND as a numeric level on the pages fetched — Berklee's How to Apply and Entrance Requirements pages do not state a TOEFL/IELTS threshold for this programme, though they require the statement of purpose ('must be in English, between 400 and 500 words'), the résumé ('in English') and the letter of recommendation ('must be written in English and signed by your recommender') all to be in English, and the admissions process includes interviews. A specific English test requirement may exist elsewhere on the Berklee site; it was NOT located and is therefore recorded as NOT FOUND rather than assumed. CANDIDATE FIT: English fluent — no obstacle. NO SPANISH IS REQUIRED for admission or teaching.
tuition_year_of_rates: 2026/2027 Academic Year — stamped as such by Berklee, and explicitly 'the direct costs charged by the college for the graduate programs starting in September 2026'. 2027-28 rates NOT PUBLISHED.
non_eu_surcharge: NO — and the reason matters. This programme is NOT priced off the Valencian public-fee decree at all: Berklee charges a single flat US-dollar tuition to every student regardless of nationality or residence. There is NO 'Estudiantado tipo 1 / tipo 2' split of the kind every UPV-taught master publishes, and DECRETO 101/2024's doubling rule for non-resident non-EU students does not reach it. So the correct reading is: no non-EU surcharge exists, because there is no discounted domestic rate to be surcharged FROM. The flat price is already far above what a non-EU student pays for any public Spanish master in this batch. Recorded as NO (with reason), not as NOT FOUND, because the fee table is complete, itemised, and applies uniformly — Berklee lists no nationality- or residence-based variation anywhere in it.
additional_fees_detail: ALL FIGURES ARE US DOLLARS, verbatim from the 2026/2027 table: 'Application Fee (Waived for Berklee alumni) $150'; 'Nonrefundable Tuition Deposit (To be credited towards first tuition payment) $2,500'; 'Tuition $50,430'; 'Comprehensive Fee (Charged entering the fall semester to all students for the cost of non-curricular facilities, programs, and services) $1,600'; 'Student Health Insurance Plan — Students must accept enrollment in Berklee's Student Health Insurance Plan (SHIP) or submit a waiver request indicating comparable coverage'; 'PROFESSIONAL RECORDING SERVICES FEE — For Master of Music in Scoring for Film, Television, and Video Games ONLY — $2,990'; 'Required Software Bundle — Scoring for Film, Television, and Video Games — $700'. The recording fee is explained verbatim: 'this mandatory fee is billed to all scoring for film, television, and video games graduate students. The fee contributes to a fraction of the extraordinary studio and recording expenses unique to the scoring program. This includes: on-campus recording sessions with professional session musicians; remote recording sessions with professional orchestras; and an off-site recording session at a world-class studio.' The software bundle is NOT optional: 'Students cannot opt out of, or receive any exemption for, purchasing their program's software bundle.' INDIRECT COSTS BERKLEE ITSELF ESTIMATES: 'Laptop (May be waived) $3,000; Housing $10,000–$12,000; Books $300–$800; Local transportation $300–$600; Personal expenses $1,000.' PENALTY FEES: '$250 late payment fee'; '$250 late check-in fee'; 'thesis continuation fee of $400' if the culminating experience is not submitted by the first day of classes of the following semester. The comprehensive fee explicitly covers 'students' required registration into the Spanish educational system' and 'students' compulsory health insurance' — i.e. the Spanish-side administrative cost is bundled, not extra.
entry_requirements: Verbatim: 'Applicants are required to hold a bachelor's degree in music composition, electronic music production, or film scoring. Outstanding musicians with bachelor's degrees in performance or OTHER DISCIPLINES, WHO HAVE A STRONG BACKGROUND IN SONGWRITING OR COMPOSITION, will also be considered.' PROFILE SOUGHT, verbatim: 'We seek focused, motivated, innovative, and, above all, passionately creative candidates with excellent academic and/or professional backgrounds. Additional study and/or work experience in the following areas will be helpful but is not required: interactive scoring techniques, conducting to picture, basic music editing skills, and project collaboration. Prospective students do not need to have extensive direct experience working with live orchestras.' Ideal candidates 'Demonstrate a strong compositional foundation from their studies and/or professional experience; POSSESS THE ABILITY TO NOTATE ONE'S IDEAS COMPETENTLY, FOLLOW AN ORCHESTRAL SCORE, AND CONCEIVE MATERIAL IN AN ORCHESTRAL CONTEXT; and Exhibit passion for musical storytelling and a demonstrated aptitude for visual music.' APPLICATION PACKAGE, verbatim: online application plus '$150 non-refundable application fee'; 'statement of purpose ... (must be in English, between 400 and 500 words)'; 'Résumé/curriculum vitae ... in English'; 'One letter of recommendation ... should come from a professional with whom you have worked or collaborated and who can convey your musical strengths and skills. Recommendations should not be done by friends or peers'; 'program-specific portfolio'; official transcripts. ⚠️ CREDENTIAL EVALUATION IS MANDATORY AND SLOW FOR A TUNISIAN DEGREE, verbatim: 'Transcripts from institutions outside the US or Canada must be evaluated by an approved third-party credential evaluation service. Berklee works closely with SpanTran and Educational Credential Evaluators, and we recommend their services. Please ask for a COURSE-BY-COURSE evaluation. The credential evaluation process CAN TAKE SEVERAL WEEKS to complete, and we strongly urge you to begin the process as early as possible. Your application will not be complete until we have received credential evaluation reports for all of your academic credentials.' And: 'We do not accept international transcripts directly from the applicant and will not accept a translation to complete an application.' Up to 40 places on this programme per the Entrance Requirements page (the programme page says 30 — see conflicts).
accepts_engineering_background: EXPLICIT BUT CONDITIONAL — and the condition is musical, not academic. The rule names 'bachelor's degrees in performance or other disciplines' as considerable, but ONLY for 'Outstanding musicians ... who have a strong background in songwriting or composition'. A Software Engineering degree is squarely an 'other discipline', so the degree itself is not a bar; the bar is the portfolio and the demonstrated compositional foundation. ⚠️ THE REAL GATE FOR THIS CANDIDATE IS NOTATION AND ORCHESTRAL LITERACY: 'Possess the ability to notate one's ideas competently, follow an orchestral score, and conceive material in an orchestral context.' A working music producer/DJ may or may not meet that; DAW-based production alone does not. This is exactly the 'what is the prueba de acceso, and can a producer's portfolio satisfy it?' question the shared brief tells us to ask, and here the published answer is: score literacy is expected, live-orchestra experience is not ('Prospective students do not need to have extensive direct experience working with live orchestras'). RECORDED AS: explicit acceptance of non-music degrees, conditional on a compositional portfolio — quoted, not inferred.
complementary_credits_required: NOT PUBLISHED IN RUCT — RUCT 4313419 omits the 'Nº Créditos Complementos Formativos' row entirely (null in output/ruct-detail.jsonl), which is NOT the same as 0. AT APPLICANT LEVEL Berklee publishes NO complementos formativos mechanism at all — as a US-style graduate programme it screens on portfolio at admission instead of bridging afterwards. There is no published route by which an admitted student takes extra preparatory credits. Effectively: you either satisfy the compositional entrance bar or you are not admitted. I am quoting Berklee's Entrance Requirements page for that, and recording RUCT's row as ABSENT.
credit_recognition_available: NOT FOUND — no credit-recognition, transfer or advanced-standing scheme is published for this programme, and none of the Valencian public-fee recognition provisions apply because the programme is not priced off the decree. The Spanish-side 300-ECTS question is therefore irrelevant here in the usual sense: entry turns on a bachelor's degree plus portfolio, and the 300-ECTS length confers no advantage. WHAT DOES MATTER FOR A 5-YEAR FOREIGN DEGREE IS THE CREDENTIAL EVALUATION, verbatim: 'Credential evaluation is a process that provides Berklee with an official report that lists the courses taken, marks received, and honors earned by an applicant in their US equivalents. For example, the report will tell us if an applicant has the equivalent of a bachelor's degree, or other academic honor(s), and will list the marks received in the standard 4.0 US grading system.' A 300-ECTS 5-year Tunisian degree should evaluate at or above US bachelor's level, which is what is required — but it must be evidenced through SpanTran or ECE at the applicant's own cost, and cannot be self-submitted.
application_window_2027: ⭐ THE ONLY PROGRAMME IN THE BATCH WITH A PUBLISHED, YEAR-INDEPENDENT DEADLINE STRUCTURE — Berklee publishes month-and-day deadlines that recur annually rather than a dated 2026-27 calendar, so these are directly usable for a September 2027 intake, although the page does not itself name 2027. Verbatim: 'To be considered for admission by our Graduate Board of Admissions, we must receive your completed application and all supporting documents by 11:59 p.m. EST on the deadline. Apply to Berklee Valencia in any of the following cycles, but consider Early Action to get a head start and take advantage of an earlier decision date along with more time for visa preparation and exclusive online opportunities to connect with your future cohort.' 'EARLY ACTION — Application deadline: November 1. Scholarship deadline: November 15. Admissions decisions issued by December 15.' 'REGULAR ACTION — Application deadline: January 15. Scholarship deadline: February 1. Admissions decisions issued by March 15.' 'EXTENDED ACTION — Application deadline: March 10. Scholarship deadline: March 10. Admissions decisions issued by April 20.' 'Note: Scholarship application deadlines are different from the Program Application deadlines for Early and Regular action.' FOR A SEPTEMBER 2027 START that implies Early Action closing 1 November 2026 with a decision by 15 December 2026 — but note the page carries no year, so treat the mapping to 2026/2027 dates as the natural reading of an annually recurring cycle rather than as a dated publication.

Regular Action — application 15 January; scholarship 1 February; decisions by 15 March

non_eu_early_round_advised: YES, AND BERKLEE SAYS SO IN THESE WORDS: 'consider Early Action to get a head start and take advantage of an earlier decision date along with MORE TIME FOR VISA PREPARATION and exclusive online opportunities to connect with your future cohort.' Two further reasons specific to a Tunisian applicant: the mandatory third-party credential evaluation 'can take several weeks to complete', and the Early Action scholarship deadline (15 November) is the earliest of the three — which matters because Berklee Valencia allocates substantial scholarship money (see scholarships_internal).

curriculum_summary: Verbatim: 'This one-year intensive Master of Music degree focuses on the art and craft of composing, orchestrating, editing, and producing music for the screen using the latest technology. Students lead recording sessions with professional session musicians and receive in-depth instruction in narrative analysis, orchestration, and the use of dramatic effects to support the story.' Headline elements: 'Creation of your own sound libraries; Live recording sessions with professional musicians; Live remote recording sessions with the Budapest Art Orchestra; LIVE RECORDING OF YOUR FINAL PROJECT IN LONDON WITH A FULL ORCHESTRA'. RECORDING PRACTICE, verbatim: 'Several times throughout the year, students record their compositions on our scoring stage with professional session musicians from the main orchestras in Valencia. Students also participate in remote recording sessions with orchestras such as the Budapest Art orchestra... The final project of the year includes a recording session at a major studio. In the past, students have recorded at AIR STUDIOS AND ABBEY ROAD STUDIOS in London.' TECHNOLOGY, verbatim: 'each station contains an Apple Desktop Computer, DAW Controller, Midi Keyboard, Sound Card, and Video Monitor(s). Up-to-date software is installed at each station, including PRO TOOLS, DIGITAL PERFORMER, LOGIC, CUBASE, VIENNA ENSEMBLE PRO, DORICO, FINALE, AND SIBELIUS (with Note Performer), each with a wide range of sample libraries and plugins available.' WORKING METHOD, verbatim: 'Projects are assigned in the same way that composers are hired in any real-world situation — including quick turnarounds, demanding producers, and the necessity to compose in a wide range of styles and genres to meet meticulous requirements. The recording sessions, both live and remote, provide students with ample experience in writing for different orchestra sizes, including a full 50-piece orchestra.' ⚠️ WHAT THIS IS NOT: it is a COMPOSITION and SCORING craft programme, not sound-and-music COMPUTING. There is no DSP, no machine learning, no music information retrieval and no software engineering content anywhere in the published description. For a candidate whose asset is engineering plus production, the fit is with the production/technology side of the industry (path P) and with screen-music craft (path A), not with the audio-AI research paths.
notable_faculty_or_lab: Programme Director: Lucio M. Godoy (film composer). Academic Committee of the Degree, verbatim: 'Simone Pilon, Executive Director, Berklee Valencia; Lucio Godoy, Program Director of Master of Music in Scoring for Film, Television, and Video Games; RAÚL TEROL BOLINCHES, UNIVERSIDAD POLITÉCNICA DE VALENCIA; Alfons Conde, Associate Professor; Martina Naretto, Senior Coordinator for Academic Assessment, Records, and Registrar Services' — note the named UPV representative on the committee, which is the visible mechanism of the UPV affiliation. Culminating Experience Jury: Alfons Conde, Lucio Godoy, Vicente Ortiz Gimeno, plus an 'External Jury (chosen by the student)'. Facilities include a scoring stage, tech labs and studios on the Palau de les Arts campus.
industry_links: ⭐ THE STRONGEST INDUSTRY LINKAGE IN THE BATCH, and it is built into the curriculum rather than bolted on: professional session musicians from Valencia's main orchestras recording on the campus scoring stage; remote sessions with the Budapest Art Orchestra; and a final-project recording at a major London studio, with Air Studios and Abbey Road named as past venues. The programme also runs a 'Visiting Artists' strand and a 'Careers' section. The $2,990 Professional Recording Services Fee is the mechanism that funds this — i.e. the industry access is real and separately billed.
thesis_or_internship: Culminating Experience (= the 6-ECTS TFM in the Spanish structure), verbatim: 'Scoring for film, television, and video games students are required to complete a culminating experience that serves as both a practicum and a bridge to the professional world. The tangible end product of this experience will take the form of an ORIGINAL SCORE, SCHOLARLY PAPER AND/OR RESEARCH PROJECT, or other enterprise that offers an original solution to the challenge of marrying music to visual media... A culminating experience committee evaluates the final project.' TIMELINE, verbatim: 'Semester One: Students propose their culminating experience to their advisor and program director. Semester Two: Students revise and refine their proposal and get final approval from their advisor. Semester Three: Students complete and present their final project to the culminating experience committee.' The 2025 cycle ran 'June 5–9: Rehearsal presentations and definitive committee selection; June 19: CE documents submission (outcome and reflective); July 1 and 2 of 2025 final presentation'. ⭐ NOTE THE RESEARCH OPTION: the CE may be 'a scholarly paper and/or research project', which is the doctoral-preparation route inside an otherwise craft-focused degree. No internship is published.

notes: COST ARITHMETIC, SHOWN, IN USD: tuition $50,430 + comprehensive fee $1,600 + professional recording services fee $2,990 + required software bundle $700 = $55,720 in mandatory direct costs, plus a $150 application fee and a $2,500 deposit that is credited against tuition.
